AUTHOR: Saleh
TITLE: How to track and segment fish without human annotations: a self-supervised deep learning approach
REGION: South-east Queensland estuaries (Seagrass) and tropical northern Australia (DeepFish); plus YouTube-VOS and Mediterranean Fish Species image set
DATA: Public datasets: Seagrass (4,280 frames), DeepFish (~40k frames, 20 habitats), YouTube-VOS fish clips (130 clips, 4,349 frames), Mediterranean Fish Species (~40k images, used for training only)
V_EV: no statement found (only generic remark: 'Evaluate our method on three public datasets with different image quality')
D2: 50/50 train/test on DeepFish, Seagrass, YouTube-VOS (unit not stated); Mediterranean train split for training
D_EV: Sec. 5: 'trained representation on 50% of the DeepFish, Seagrass, YouTube-VOS datasets ... We then evaluated it in the other 50% of the first three datasets.' (unit unspecified)
R_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'We train our feature extractor on all of the four datasets and evaluate it on the video datasets only' (each test set from a training dataset)
C_EV: Sec. 4.4: 'to filter out predictions with low confidence, we use a threshold of 0.1'; no threshold sensitivity, false-positive or uncertainty analysis
E_EV: Table 1: only COCO-style 'APM AP.50 AP.75 APL ARM ARL' for detection and segmentation; no ecological variable
ARCH: Pseudo-labels from background subtraction + RAFT optical flow, refined by DeepLabv3+CRF moving-average self-training; SOLOv2 instance segmentation; min-area rotated boxes; SORT tracking
METR: COCO AP/AR (AP.50, AP.75, APM, APL, ARM, ARL) for boxes and masks
NOTE: D1=NR: 50/50 split of each dataset with unit (video vs frame) not stated; DeepFish's own predefined split not used. All datasets were used in training, so no external test (R1=N); 'generalising to unseen videos' claim is in-distribution. C: SOLOv2 score threshold 0.1 used as-is with no FP/uncertainty analysis -> N under normal rule (a reading of the policy parenthetical 'C1 = Y alone -> P' would give P; that parenthetical is stated for classification-only studies). Tracking (SORT) shown only qualitatively; no ID-switch/MOT metrics. E4='크기별' because AP/AR reported for medium and large objects. YouTube-VOS clips are web videos (not in situ) and Mediterranean images unspecified, but core Seagrass/DeepFish data are in situ underwater -> INCL=Y. PRE not stated.
